data.title: list_followups — cross-plan unresolved followup scanner
data.summary: New store fn list_followups_across(project, unresolved_only=True) scans all *.json in state dir, skips index.json and project.json. MCP tool _list_followups returns {project, count, followups[{slug, followup_id, title, blocked_by, tier, written_at}]}.

sections.body: Add list_followups_across(project: str, unresolved_only: bool = True) -> list[dict] to reckon/_store.py. Globs _state_root()/project/*.json, skips slugs 'index' and 'project'. For each file, reads via _load_envelope(), iterates data.get('followups', []). When unresolved_only=True, skips items where f.get('resolved_at') is truthy. Returns lightweight dicts: {slug, followup_id, title, blocked_by, est_turn, tier, written_at}.

Add _list_followups(project: str, unresolved_only: bool = True) to reckon/mcp.py. Imports list_followups_across from reckon._store. Returns {project: project, count: len(items), followups: items}. Register with mcp.tool() at bottom of file. Add ListFollowupsArgs(project: str, unresolved_only: bool = True) to reckon/_mcp_tools.py.

In tests/test_mcp_tools.py: test_list_followups_empty_project (no files → []), test_list_followups_unresolved_only (mix resolved/unresolved; filter correct), test_list_followups_all (unresolved_only=False returns all), test_list_followups_skips_meta (index.json and project.json excluded), test_list_followups_cross_plan (3 plan files; followups from all 3 aggregated).
